title: Breaking Free from Depression and Anxiety
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner for a powerful and uplifting sermon that will help you overcome anxiety, depression, and fear as you receive a breakthrough in your life. In this message, Pastor Chris shares a bold and liberating truth: that the Spirit of the Lord is raising up a standard in you right now to conquer the enemy and bring peace, joy, and freedom. If you're feeling stuck or struggling with dark emotions, don't miss this inspiring and life-changing sermon that will leave you feeling empowered and renewed.
